# Reusable Templates

Every file in this directory is inert. Copy the required template to an
appropriate project-record, review, plan, or history location before filling
it. Never turn the template itself into a live record.

Synthetic placeholders use `{{name}}` or `example.test`. They are not project
facts, approvals, defaults, or instructions to implement a feature.

## Template Groups

- **Orientation and planning:** `current-state`, `task-route`, `preflight`,
  `project-brief`, `technical-specification`, `execution-plan`, and
  `completion-criteria`.
- **Authority and queues:** `decision-entry`, `open-question-entry`,
  `deferred-work-entry`, `queued-plan`, and `owner-review-queue`.
- **Delegation and implementation:** `authorization-packet`,
  `implementation-review`, `correction-packet`, `handoff`, and
  `resume-checkpoint`.
- **Content and research:** `content-record`, `source-ledger`, and
  `inventory-and-intent-map`.
- **Audit and reconciliation:** `audit-protocol`, `audit-matrix`,
  `audit-record-report`, `audit-batch-report`, `final-reconciliation`,
  `report-reconciliation`, and `snapshot-manifest`.
- **Design, data, and release:** `design-handoff`, `rendered-review`,
  `data-flow-inventory`, `migration-import-plan`, and
  `deployment-runbook`.
- **Review and evidence:** `external-review-register`,
  `review-impact-record`, `activity-log`, `experiment-record`, and
  `completion-report`.
- **Extending the system:** `procedure-template`.
